item.title: UK unemployment rate unexpectedly drops as job vacancies fall further
item.body: The UK unemployment rate has unexpectedly dropped, while job vacancies have fallen further. The ONS director of economic statistics said it was a 'mixed picture overall'.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 📊 UK unemployment rate unexpectedly drops as job vacancies fall further

The UK unemployment rate has unexpectedly dropped, while job vacancies have fallen further. The ONS director of economic statistics said it was a 'mixed picture overall'.

Source: The Independent | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 17 November, 09:50
